search_text: published ZDI-21-128 ZDI-CAN-11483 (0Day) Apache Dubbo decodeBody Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-02-02 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Apache'] ['Dubbo'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apache Dubbo. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the Dubbo protocol. Crafted data in a Dubbo protocol message can trigger the deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. title: (0Day) Apache Dubbo decodeBody Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apache Dubbo. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
